turnos.t: Biotic: the living parts, like food, competitors, predators and pathogens. Abiotic: physical and chemical, like temperature, light, water, pH and salinity. For interactions, ask who gains and who loses. Predation, herbivory and parasitism are plus–minus. Mutualism is plus–plus. Competition is minus–minus, and it can be intraspecific or interspecific.
